needs_human.note: Paused→playing allowance: a seek and play issued together from a paused state, for example by another panel, that lands up to about elapsed×rate + 2 s ahead (about 3 s at rate 1, more after a throttled background-tab interval) is not treated as a jump. A touch or keyboard browse point then survives a real seek. §9 does not say how to judge the transition sample.; Changing the source: once a keyboard browse point exists, a mouse hover over the ruler turns it into a mouse browse point. A later focus-leave then keeps it, and only pointer-leave clears it. The reverse also holds. The spec gives no rule for a point re-set by a different input.; If the YouTube controller throws during tick, mediaClock skips notifying (mediaClock.ts:119-125), so previous.at in usePlaybackClock grows stale. The next paused→playing sample then gets a larger forward allowance.
